notes: Houses are no longer pitch black by day: indoors your eyes adjust to the dim light (nights stay dark).
A torch held in hand now gives light (craft one, then right-click it to take it in hand).
One of the Haldersfield spawns is now about 170 m south of the village street, on the same side of the river.
Trees no longer grow inside village houses, and furniture no longer pokes through house walls.

Haldersfield has a village: ten furnished houses along the main road (cabins, family homes, a pensioner's house, a handyman's place and one big house) with doors, rooms and loot that fits each home: kitchens and fridges, bathroom cabinets, wardrobes, tool shelves.
Sheds stand behind some of the houses and a few abandoned cars along the road have something in the boot.
Loot, trees, rocks and zombie groups are now different in every new world. Worlds you already play keep what they had.
Water has a cold Nordic look: a deep blue-green sea, dark clear lakes and slightly lighter, clearer rivers (no more bright turquoise).
The sea has gentle moving waves and the lakes small ripples.
The lakes hold water again: Storwater and the other lakes were dry beds before, and Blackwater Reservoir had no water at all.
Village houses have doors on the outside only; rooms inside are open, and the houses are furnished but bare (no lights, no pictures or small stories yet).
Very shallow river water, mostly near the river mouths, still shows a bright turquoise edge.
There is no foam where the sea meets the beach yet.
